name: proxy-url-app

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.//operator-scripts: The trailing `--` is load-bearing on every script below that takes arguments: it is what lets `npm run db:revalidate -- CLM1 CLM2` reach the workspace instead of being eaten by the root npm. Anything added to server/package.json must be forwarded here too -- an operator on the deploy box runs from C:\ProxyApp, not C:\ProxyApp\server, and a script that exists only in the workspace fails there with a bare "Missing script", which reads as a broken deploy rather than a missing alias.
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:api && npm run test:e2e:ui
scripts.deploy: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run build
scripts.redeploy: npm run pm2:stop && npm run deploy && pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.js

//allowScripts: npm 11 blocks dependency install scripts until they are approved here; bcrypt and canvas need theirs to resolve their native bindings. Write entries with `npm install-scripts approve <pkg>` rather than by hand -- the key must carry the version (`pkg@1.2.3`), and a plain `pkg: version` entry is silently ignored. Pinning means a version bump re-prompts instead of inheriting approval. tesseract.js is denied: its postinstall is only an Open Collective funding message.
//optionalDependencies: The lockfile is generated on macOS, so it only carries darwin-arm64 native binaries and no other platform can resolve its own -- `npm ci` refuses to write the lockfile, so a binary absent from it is silently skipped, not fetched. Listing every platform we run on forces them all in; npm installs only the matching one because each declares os/cpu. win32-x64 is the deploy box, linux-x64 is CI (ubuntu-latest) -- without it a native binary is missing, `vite` dies at startup, and the ui-e2e job times out waiting for a dev server that never booted. Keep the versions in step with rolldown (vite), lightningcss and @tailwindcss/oxide (tailwind), esbuild (tsx) and @napi-rs/canvas. lightningcss is pinned at the hoisted 1.32.0 that @tailwindcss/node requires exactly; vite's own 1.33.0 sits nested under node_modules/vite and cannot be pinned from here, so check its win32/linux entries are still in the lockfile after an update.
//overrides: @types/express-serve-static-core is held at 5.0.7: 5.1 types every req.params value as string | string[] (for Express 5 wildcards), which breaks 101 `:id`-style reads in 18 route files whose handlers annotate `req: Request`. Runtime is unaffected; lift the hold together with typed route params. server also lists it as an exact devDependency: an override alone left it nested under @types/express, and declaration emit then failed (TS2883) on every exported router. zod is forced to >=4.6.6 for GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5: jimp 1.6.1, still the latest jimp, pins zod 3.25.76. pdf-parse 2 pins its own pdfjs-dist 5; it is pointed at the server's pdfjs-dist version. @napi-rs/canvas is held at 1.0.11 everywhere (pdf-parse pins 0.1, and both pdfjs-dist copies would otherwise nest the newest 1.x): one native canvas per process, and the copy that matches the win32/linux pins in optionalDependencies. Not 1.0.12+: that release changed how patterns are sampled (Brooooooklyn/canvas#1357), which changed the raster of scanned pages and so what OCR reads. On the QA set it dropped real duplicate-address and Missing Bill findings and added a false invoice/date flag, and no imageSmoothingQuality setting restores the old output. 1.0.11 rasterizes byte-identical to the 0.1.x line and satisfies pdfjs-dist ^1.0.10. Lift the hold only after an OCR before/after comparison.
